## Born with a Tail

In the water a merfolk's legs are a fish's tail, and nothing in the sea swims faster. On land they walk like anyone else, and are hunted like nobody else.

Be of the Merfolk race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Merfolk race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

## Sabaody's Shadow

A mermaid at the Sabaody auction sells for more than a pirate's bounty. Some merfolk never come home.

Go to Sabaody and set three prisoners free.

**Prerequisites (any of)** — [Ultramarine](r_merfolk.md#q-7ca954e1c03b98ea), [Trident Assault](r_merfolk.md#q-10e7864ed39e3d69)

**Tasks**

- Visit the Sabaody Archipelago
- Free 3 prisoners

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +6 Training Points (your race)

## Neptune's Court

When the New Fish-Man Pirates came for the throne, it took the whole kingdom, and a few outsiders, to stop them.

Reach 30,000 Doriki and defeat twenty-five pirates on Fish-Man Island.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sabaody's Shadow](r_merfolk.md#q-2583bfc03f982970), [Siren Song](r_merfolk.md#q-36c1f5cd6c5e5ce5), [Karakusagawara Seiken](r_merfolk.md#q-1d11fb095100e4c8)

**Tasks**

- Reach 30,000 Doriki
- Defeat 25 pirates on Fish-Man Island

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +100,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your race)
